## After merge

---

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`feat:`, `fix:`, `feat!:` for breaking changes)
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy`, `cargo test` and `cargo deny check` pass; changed snapshots reviewed
- [ ] `GLOSSARY.md`, ADRs and docs updated if behaviour or terms changed
- [ ] No API keys, `.env` files or local agent files are included
